app.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights are out
app.author: abrarthought
app.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a large language model released by Moonshot AI, available on Hugging Face with full weights for local inference.
proposed_tests: Clone the Hugging Face repo and download the weights
Load the model with Hugging Face Transformers
Run a generation test with a prompt and record output length and latency
Verify that the model can generate text without requiring GPU if using CPU-only inference
